title: Google Home Script Editor Latency
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=googlehome:event source=script_editor
| stats avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, perc95(latency_ms) as p95_latency_ms by household
| where p95_latency_ms>5000
| sort - p95_latency_ms
description: Uses Google Home script-editor runs telemetry to monitor household automation latency at the slow tail in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for scripted actions that feel noticeably delayed, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Google Home script-editor runs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Household table of average and p95 latency.
grandmaExplanation: It frames household automation latency at the slow tail so you can spot scripted actions that feel noticeably delayed before it becomes annoying.
